project.title: Indoor ambient sulfur dioxide disrupts surface bacterial viability, biofilm formation, and community composition.
project.description: Sulfur dioxide in indoor environments reduces bacterial viability, inhibits biofilm maturation, and alters surface-associated bacterial communities.
